decision_log.rationale:
All three pipeline stages passed successfully with no replanning required:

**Ingestor ✅** — Ingested 177,310 raw GEDI shots and accepted 89,400 (49.6% accepted) using sensitivity_min=0.95 and slope_max_deg=30°. Shot density is 9.3 shots/km² over a 9,608 km² AOI, which is sufficient for modeling. Sentinel-2 coverage is solid with 142 scenes and 20.4% mean cloud cover.

**Transformer ✅** — Matched GEDI shots to Sentinel-2 bands with a 0.0% NaN rate. Spatial CV blocks were computed at 28.75 km (capped from 43.4 km to guarantee ≥ 3×3 blocks). 5,000 cleaned shots were written across 5 folds (train: 4,338 | test: 662) to gedi_shots_cleaned.

**QA ✅** — All four QA checks passed: clean feature distributions across all 8 S2 bands (0% NaN), all 5 folds within acceptable balance range (13.2%–28.9%), and rh98 target range of [2.31m, 74.12m] with only 0.1% implausibly high values (well below the 10% threshold). Dataset is clean and ready for model training.
